name: Kurusu Hikaru
source:
"If you were a girl, you'd want to pamper a cute boy, wouldn't you think so?"

Likes: Pampering [url=/c125620]Shinra[/url]

Undeniably, a well-grown girl who is a part of the "Childhood Friend Corps". She is a member of the swimming club, and as a first-year student, she has already become the team's ace. However, she does not seem have any attachment to the competitions.

She has a gentle and kind personality, a girl who is truly an embodiment of motherhood. At heart, she is a firm person and excels in household chores. Ever since she was a child, she finds great joy in pampering Shinra, bringing his face to her well-grown chest, she hugs him and pats him like a child.

For some reason, she has an overactive bladder​, which is her weak point.

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://hulotte.jp/product/vision/character/hikaru.html]official website[/url]]
